title: Affine pointed etale chart of the punctured root cover
statement: For R, g, positive n invertible in R and y in Spec R off g, put A=R[T]/(T^n-g), q:Spec A to Spec R and V=D(algebraMap R A g). There exist S, phi:R to S, z in Spec S and an isomorphism e:Spec S to V over Spec R such that Spec phi is etale, maps z to y, and phi(g) is a unit. Scheme and spectrum conventions are those of def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions.

source.place: Tag 0EYG, off-divisor branch; standard localization and degree-one root algebra calculation

proof.text: Construct S, phi and e with the affine localization chart theorem; it supplies the over-base identity and the unit phi(g).
The punctured root cover V to Spec R is etale by the explicit standard etale presentation, and admits a point v above y by faithful flatness of the positive-degree monic root algebra.

Set z=e.inv(v). The identity e.hom(e.inv(v))=v and compatibility over Spec R show that Spec phi sends z to y. Composition of the isomorphism e with the etale map from V gives etaleness of Spec phi. Assemble the existential witness with the unit condition. All ring data come from the explicit localization; only a prime above y is selected.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EYG off-divisor application; explicit localization, standard etale pair, faithfully-flat lifting, and transport checked in Lean.
